**For Segment**: 

The following is the error code displayed when the Segment messaging is disabled for your tenant.


```json
{

  "code": 70,

  "description": "Segment based messaging feature is not available for your tenant"

}
```





> **Note**
> 
> To enable the Segment messaging for your tenant, contact your account manager.




> **Know Your Endpoint**
> 
> Based on the domain you use to log in to imiconnect, the endpoint for your API varies. See the [endpoint](https://developers.imiconnect.io/reference/endpoints) section to understand which endpoint to use for your domain.

## OpenAPI operation and component schemas

```json
{
  "openapi": "3.1.0",
  "info": {
    "title": "Segment APIs",
    "version": "6.20.0"
  },
  "servers": [
    {
      "url": "https://rtm.imiconnect.io/rtmsAPI/api/v1"
    }
  ],
  "security": [
    {
      "sec0": []
    }
  ],
  "path": "/apps/{inappid}/segments/{segmentid}",
  "method": "put",
  "path_parameters": [],
  "operation": {
    "summary": "Update a Segment",
    "description": "This API is used to update a segment for a topic",
    "operationId": "segment-apis-update",
    "parameters": [
      {
        "name": "Content-Type",
        "in": "header",
        "description": "Application/JSON",
        "schema": {
          "type": "string"
        }
      },
      {

        "schema": {
          "type": "string"
        }
      },
      {
        "name": "inappid",
        "in": "path",
        "description": "The unique identifier corresponding to the app asset",
        "schema": {
          "type": "string"
        },
        "required": true
      },
      {
        "name": "segmentid",
        "in": "path",
        "description": "The unique identifier corresponding to your segment",
        "schema": {
          "type": "string"
        },
        "required": true
      }
    ],
    "requestBody": {
      "content": {
        "application/json": {
          "schema": {
            "type": "object",
            "required": [
              "criteria"
            ],
            "properties": {
              "criteria": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "Criteria can be used to define a category of a segment, or it can be a combination of topics with logical operators (& | ! symbols). This is an optional parameter. You can add users to a segment and make a group without defining it's criteria . For topic-based criteria, based on the criteria condition the user base will be prepared to send push/in-app messages. For example, if Sports and News are topics, the criteria can be Sports&News *both Sports and News), or, Sports|News (either Sports or News)."
              },
              "name": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "Name of the segment"
              }
            }
          },

              }

        }
      }
    },

              }
            },
            "schema": {
              "type": "object",
              "properties": {
                "code": {
                  "type": "integer",
                  "example": 0,
                  "default": 0
                },
                "description": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "example": "Success"
                },
                "trans_id": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "example": "71116ff7-9a1e-4a1a-9cba-7a763b304b8d"
                }
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    },
    "deprecated": false,
    "x-readme": {
      "code-samples": [
        {
```
